description: Email spoofing protection of a domain: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, BIMI. Reads the domain's mail DNS records and tells whether someone can forge email from it: SPF policy and lookup count, DMARC policy and reporting, DKIM keys on common selectors, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI, with a verdict and a list of issues to fix. Use before trusting a sender domain or when auditing your own. Price $0.020 per call (x402: USDC on Base or Solana).
